content.short: Tristero is a non-custodial encrypted exchange for private order matching and cross-chain trades.
content.description: Tristero matches orders under encryption so that trading intent is not broadcast before execution, which on a transparent chain is the difference between getting filled and being front-run. Private matching with non-custodial settlement is a hard combination, and it is the specific problem this protocol takes on.
content.meta: Encrypted order matching, so intent is not broadcast before execution on a transparent chain.
